headline: Forward Thinking Engineer
summary: Forward Thinking Engineer. Focus: shadowing employees to learn how they work, building each person a custom AI agent that fits their day, and teaching them to use it well, then scaling across the company. Independent, AI-assisted developer of local workflow tools, desktop interfaces and source-grounded review workflows. Background includes service and hands-on work.

experience.title: Independent Project Development - AI-Assisted Software & Evaluation
experience.intro: Direct AI-assisted implementation, debugging, testing and review of local tools, API integrations and documented human next steps.

projects.name: Ergon - Windows Employee Assistant & Remote Support
bullets: Built and delivered a Windows employee-assistant installer with native Outis taskbar management and a Linux support service; the setup preserves employee data across upgrades.
Implemented ticket-driven REST connector builds with exact read/write grants and device-scoped screen-control tools; activation and rollback require a local Gateway check.
projects.short: Built and delivered a Windows assistant installer with native Outis management, connector builds and device-scoped screen-support tools.

projects.name: Industry AI Suite - Source-Grounded Review Tools
projects.stack: Python, HTTP APIs, Local LLMs, HTML/CSS/JavaScript
bullets: Built ten local review tools for finance, research, security and operations, with source receipts, human review, durable history, export and deletion.
Added optional loopback model drafts from minimized findings, with citation checks and explicit failure handling.
projects.short: Built ten source-grounded review tools with human review, durable history, export and deletion; the current suite passes 382 tests.

projects.name: dotz - Multi-Agent Coding Dashboard
bullets: Built a Rust and Tauri coding-agent desktop with supervised tools, explicit provider routing and platform-specific process cleanup.
Made local-model failures clear and added safe cleanup retries. Cross-platform CI passed on Linux, Windows and macOS.
projects.short: Built a Rust and Tauri coding-agent desktop with supervised tools; Linux, Windows and macOS CI passed.

projects.name: Sophos - Coding-Agent Desktop
bullets: Connected selected agent profiles to real daemon sessions and local model catalogs, with durable transcripts and restart recovery.
Added daemon-backed context summarization, preserved provider configuration and clear runtime errors, with automated session and recovery checks.
projects.short: Connected agent profiles and local model catalogs to real daemon sessions, with durable transcripts and restart recovery.

projects.name: Asmodeus - Research & Paper Replay
bullets: Built a research and paper-replay system with verified historical data, chronological evaluation, persisted cursors, fees and duplicate-fill prevention.
Added a guarded keyless local-model route, chronological train/validation/test slices and reviewable refutation records. The merged implementation passed Windows CI.
projects.short: Built a research and paper-replay system with historical-data provenance, chronological evaluation and restart-safe simulated fills.

skills: React, Tauri, axum, REST, WebSockets, JSON-RPC, SQLite
Coding-agent orchestration, local LLM/API integration, source-grounded review, regression testing, pytest, Vitest, Cargo, Git/GitHub, Linux
